Manage GitHub PAT entries and VM assignments

Usage: iso github <COMMAND>

Commands:
  assign-pat    Select an existing stored PAT entry for subsequent VM sessions
  unassign-pat  Remove only the VM association; keep the shared stored credential
  setup-pat     Run the fine-grained PAT wizard for a repo
  rotate-pat    Re-run the wizard against an existing entry
  status        Print configured PAT entries and their validation state
  forget-pat    Remove a configured PAT entry and its stored secret
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
